name: Wildfire Devils
oracle_text: When this creature enters and at the beginning of your upkeep, choose a player at random. That player exiles an instant or sorcery card from their graveyard. Copy that card. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters and at the beginning of your upkeep, choose a player at random.

needs.what: a `random: true` option on `choose_player` that binds one seat drawn uniformly at random from the `players` pool (here every living player, you included) under `as`, with no decision asked, so the later `exile` (chooser that player, from that player's graveyard) and `cast_copy` can read it with {"binding": ...}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `choose_player` takes only `as`, `players` and `prompt` and always asks the controller via ask_player; `random` exists only as a selector key over objects (cards in a zone) and on `choose_mode`, and a random `choose_mode` over a 'you' mode and an 'opponent' mode is not uniform over players at a multiplayer table. The rest of the line (exile by the chosen player, then `cast_copy` optional of the exiled card, as Arcane Bombardment writes it) is expressible once the seat can be bound
